cta.message: I would like to discuss my case with MediVasc.

hero.lead: Prevention of foot and leg amputation
hero.evidenceBody: Below-knee amputation was advised. Therapy prevented it.

recoveries.heading: Recoveries you can see
recoveries.lede: Every story below is a real MediVasc case, shown exactly as photographed: before, during, and after therapy. We never generate or edit outcome images. Names are withheld where patients asked for privacy.

treatment.heading: Patients undergoing treatment
treatment.lede: Current MediVasc patients, photographed during their therapy. Their progress is ongoing, and we’ll add their after photographs as they recover.

voices.heading: What patients say about us
voices.lede: Unedited messages from patients and their families, shared with their permission. Tap any note to read it in full.

approach.heading: The therapy comes to you
approach.lede: Hospital and clinic therapy for these conditions runs long, and every session means a visit. Many patients never manage it: there is no clinic in the vicinity, mobility is already limited, a family member must give up the whole day, and the travel and therapy costs deter treatment altogether. Our approach removes every one of those barriers.

steps.title: Detailed case study
steps.body: We begin with your individual case: the condition, its history, current treatment, and reports. No two protocols are the same because no two cases are.

steps.title: A customized, affordable solution
steps.body: Where required, we customize the medical device modalities for your therapy, designed around your case, your home, and your budget.

steps.title: Therapy at home, under our guidance
steps.body: You take the therapy at home, guided by us, without any break: no travel, no waiting rooms, no dependence on anyone to get you there.

steps.title: Follow-ups
steps.body: We follow up at planned intervals to check the progress and adjust the plan.

approach.mottoLine: A solution is not a solution unless it is affordable
approach.mottoBody: That is our motto, and we mean it literally. The solutions are designed not to pinch the pockets of patients and families already struggling with rising medical expenses.

conditions.heading: Conditions we support
conditions.lede: Every protocol starts with the same detailed case study. If your condition is not listed here, ask us. The case study decides what is possible.
conditions.caseQuote: A top hospital had already referred this patient for a below-knee amputation. He recovered in 90 days instead, keeping his leg and sparing his family at least ₹7 lakh in surgery costs, and the anguish that goes with it.

watch.heading: Vulnerability — signs to watch out for
watch.lede: These are the signs that a wound, a limb, or the circulation needs attention. If any of them apply to you or someone you care for, have it assessed without waiting.
items: Dark red / black spots on lower limbs

act.heading: If amputation has been advised, talk to us today
act.body: The recovery shown above began after a vascular surgeon had already referred the patient for below-knee amputation. Early assessment and appropriate care improve the chance of limb preservation. One message is enough to begin.

consult.title: No consultation charges
consult.text: At any stage of the case study or follow-ups

contact.heading: Start with your case
contact.body: Tell us the condition, how long it has persisted, and what treatment has been tried. We will study the case and tell you honestly what a protocol can do.

footer.disclaimer: Recovery time varies for every patient depending on cause & duration of the condition, comorbidities and the patient’s participation in treatment & follow-ups. Recovery timeline may vary from our stated estimates.

chat.name: MediVasc Assistant
chat.nudgeBody: Request a customized solution in ~30 seconds.
chat.legal: Opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send. A person replies. This isn’t medical advice.
chat.greeting: Namaste 🙏 I’m the MediVasc Assistant. A few quick taps and I’ll set up your request for a customized solution.

questions.prompt: What medical condition are you seeking a solution for? Pick one below or type your own.

chat.done: Perfect. Here’s your request. Send it to us on WhatsApp and we’ll get back to you personally.
chat.welcomeBack: Welcome back 🙏 Here’s the request you set up. Send it on WhatsApp whenever you’re ready.
chat.restart: No problem, let’s update the details.
chat.messageOpening: Hello MediVasc, I would like to request a solution.
chat.messageClosing: Please advise on a possible protocol.
